summary: Conservative reconciliation of two validated proposals (ui_platform_and_options_01, wave_001_ui_platform_and_options_01) sharing the ui_platform_and_options scope. One engine subsystem UiPlatformAndOptions is emitted as the scope grouping: its dominant, DERIVED responsibility is the options/settings UI platform (PlayerOptions initializer 0x004AA270 building the named category-group options tree under UIControlWindowInitialization 0x004A70E0; UI-object destructor 0x00494470; device state-18 setter 0x00554560; mutex-guarded thread suspend 0x005855E0 flagged by the packet as part of the ai subsystem). The scope also carries two evidence-unrelated helpers with no common ownership: ConstraintComplianceMatrix builder 0x004364A0 and a settings-path builder 0x004A1EC0. Three canonical type families are kept separate and unmerged: PlayerOptions (DERIVED, source ui_platform_and_options_01:0), ConstraintComplianceMatrix (GUESS synthesis over an UnknownObject owner), SettingsPathBuilder (GUESS synthesis over an UnknownObject owner). Two interfaces are carried from proposal 1 (SettingsGroupBuilder on 0x004A1EC0, StringFieldRegistrar on 0x004A1E20). Two state machines are carried from proposal 1 (DeviceState18, OptionsTreeEnableFlag). Four contradictions are recorded in conflicts rather than erased: the 0x004A1EC0 role split (SettingsGroupBuilder vs SettingsPathBuilder), the packet-internal class/owner inconsistency in wave_001 (function-role owner fields name classes while summary/unresolved state both owners are UnknownObject and the classes are synthesis), the ai-vs-ui_platform ownership boundary of 0x005855E0, and the GUESS class boundary of ConstraintComplianceMatrix. All five source contracts are preserved as compatibility contracts. Five evidence refs (abi:lead, caller:0x005546A0, global:0x0059E420, global:0x0059E430) are carried to unresolved_evidence_refs. No trust was promoted beyond DERIVED/GUESS/UNKNOWN.

engine_subsystems.name: UiPlatformAndOptions
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Evidence-grouped ui_platform_and_options scope. Dominant responsibility: options/settings UI platform. PlayerOptions initializer (0x004AA270) builds the player options tree (named category groups Scene/Driver/DrivingAids/RaceConditions/SoundOptions/GraphicOptions/GameOptions/MultiplayerOptions/Options/Controls, string-field registrations, 9-dword option entries, default control-action key bindings, root enable-flag lifecycle) and runs under UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0). 0x00494470 destroys UI objects through a vtable-0x005AC830-installing base-chain destructor with optional self-free. 0x00554560 sets device state 18 by dispatching vtable+252 on the object at global 0x008B89A0. 0x005855E0 suspends an AI thread under mutex with a 50-attempt retry loop (packet flags it as part of the ai subsystem despite delivery here). The scope additionally carries two evidence-unrelated helpers: 0x004364A0 builds a 15-double constraint compliance matrix, and 0x004A1EC0 builds a settings file path; neither shares ownership evidence with the UI platform.

canonical_type_families.name: PlayerOptions
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Owns and initializes the player options / settings tree: named category groups of 9-dword (36-byte) option entries, string-field registrations, control-action default key bindings, and the root enable-flag life-cycle. Built by 0x004AA270 under UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No field: evidence refs in packet, so no class fields emitted. Option-entry layout (9-dword/36-byte entries: label char*, value/min/max/selector dwords, description char*, offsets 0x0..0x14 plus three trailing unproven dwords) is inferred from recurring 4-dword writes in raw source and is recorded as a boundary clue in unresolved, not as a complete layout.

canonical_type_families.name: ConstraintComplianceMatrix
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Holds the 15-double (0x78-byte) constraint compliance matrix written by 0x004364A0 as products of input scalars and a5 vector components, plus two rows normalized by 1/sqrt(a2); returns nonzero iff any of this[0..12] is non-zero. Parameter semantics are defined by caller 0x0043C250. The class boundary itself is inferred: the packet reports the owner as UnknownObject, so the class is synthesis at GUESS.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Contiguous 15-double (0x78-byte) layout at this+0x0..+0x70. Field samples are boundary clues, not a complete class layout; entry semantics (3x5 grouping, which entries carry parameter products, the two 1/sqrt(a2)-normalized rows) are packet-sourced and DERIVED only. The class boundary is GUESS.

canonical_type_families.name: SettingsPathBuilder
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Constructs a settings file path in a local buffer by concatenating the application directory (byte_5EA438), a base file path (asc_5CD148), a caller-supplied player-specific identifier, and a file suffix (asc_5CD144), then passes the completed path to 0x004A1B70 and returns that call's result. The buffer is local, not evidenced as a field, so no class fields are proposed. The class is synthesis at GUESS: the packet reports the owner as UnknownObject.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No class fields proposed; the path buffer is local to 0x004A1EC0 and not evidenced as a field.

interfaces.name: SettingsGroupBuilder
interfaces.purpose: Builds the named category path (e.g. Scene, Driver, SoundOptions) under which option entries are registered. NOTE: 0x004A1EC0 is given a contradictory role by the other proposal (settings-path builder); the conflict is recorded in conflicts and this interface is retained unmerged.

interfaces.name: StringFieldRegistrar
interfaces.purpose: Registers a string-valued field into the current settings group (used for scene file, profile vehicle, telemetry exe/file, GDB filename, player livery).

compatibility_contracts.name: UIObjectLifetime
compatibility_contracts.description: UI object destruction must install vtable 0x005AC830 at this+0x0, chain to the base UI destructor (0x00485EB0), and when the flag argument has bit 0 set free the object allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); the call still returns this.

compatibility_contracts.name: DeviceState18Set
compatibility_contracts.description: Setting device state 18 for a2 0/1 must dispatch through vtable+252 on the object at global 0x008B89A0 (state 18, value 0 / 1-or-2 depending on bit 0 of global byte 0x008B8C48), skip when a2 == -1 or equals the last applied value, and record the last applied value at this+0x34.

compatibility_contracts.name: PlayerOptionsTreeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The options/settings tree is populated as named category groups (Scene, Driver, DrivingAids, RaceConditions, SoundOptions, GraphicOptions, GameOptions, MultiplayerOptions, Options, Controls); each option entry is a 9-dword (36-byte) group holding a label, value/min/max/selector dwords and a description string; indexed lists use 7-entry loops with per-index formatted names; all control actions are bound to default key codes; the root enable flag is set to 1 at start and cleared to 0 at end.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConstraintMatrixLayoutAndReturn
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x004364A0 must write 15 doubles into the this-referenced buffer at offsets +0x0..+0x70 (contiguous 0x78-byte layout) and return a non-zero value exactly when any of the first 13 entries (this[0]..this[12]) is non-zero. Caller 0x0043C250 relies on both the written matrix and the return value.

compatibility_contracts.name: SettingsPathConcatenationOrder
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x004A1EC0 must build the settings path by concatenating, in order: the application directory string (byte_5EA438), the base file path (asc_5CD148), the caller-supplied player identifier, and the file suffix (asc_5CD144); it must then call 0x004A1B70 with the completed path and propagate that call's return value. The referenced globals must remain readable as string data in the same order.

conflicts.subject: Role of 0x004A1EC0
alternatives: SettingsGroupBuilder (proposal ui_platform_and_options_01): builds the named category path (Scene, Driver, SoundOptions, ...) under which option entries are registered.

SettingsPathBuilder (proposal wave_001_ui_platform_and_options_01): concatenates application directory + base path + player identifier + file suffix into a path buffer, forwards it to ShortComputation_1b70 (0x004A1B70) and returns that result.
conflicts.resolution: Both interpretations are grounded in the raw source of the same function and contradict each other. Do not merge. Retain the SettingsPathBuilder class (GUESS) and the SettingsGroupBuilder interface (DERIVED) as separate entries, and leave the semantic resolution to a later candidate or the raw source of 0x004A1EC0. The call edges 0x004AA270->0x004A1EC0 and 0x004A1EC0->0x004A1B70 are consistent across both proposals and are kept.

conflicts.subject: wave_001_ui_platform_and_options_01 class proposals vs packet owner reporting
alternatives: function_roles owner fields name the classes ConstraintComplianceMatrix and SettingsPathBuilder for 0x004364A0 / 0x004A1EC0.
summary and unresolved state both owners are reported as UnknownObject and that the proposed classes are synthesis, not confirmed source-level types.
conflicts.resolution: Packet-internal inconsistency. Both proposed classes are demoted to GUESS synthesis over UnknownObject owners and are not promoted; the field footprint of ConstraintComplianceMatrix is kept as boundary clues.

conflicts.subject: Subsystem ownership of 0x005855E0
alternatives: ai subsystem: the packet summary describes SuspendThreadWithMutex (0x005855E0) as part of the ai subsystem.
ui_platform_and_options scope: 0x005855E0 is delivered inside the ui_platform_and_options proposal scope.
conflicts.resolution: Ownership boundary is ambiguous; the owner class (thread + mutex + flag grouping) is unconfirmed. Keep 0x005855E0 listed under the UiPlatformAndOptions subsystem as the delivery scope, claim no owner class, and leave ai-vs-ui ownership unresolved.

conflicts.subject: ConstraintComplianceMatrix class boundary
alternatives: UnknownObject owner for 0x004364A0 per packet reporting.
ConstraintComplianceMatrix class proposal (GUESS) inferred from the 15-double footprint.
conflicts.resolution: The class boundary is inferred solely from the field footprint and is retained at GUESS; it is not promoted to a confirmed source-level type.
